integrity: All-parameter claims have a written proof; exact enumeration is supplemental and is not an independent external audit. Priority is best-knowledge and may be affected by unindexed weighted-kernel literature.
scientific_limitations: Specialized equilibria only; fixed cycle architecture and independent symmetric orientation/reciprocation; fixed positive reciprocity for typical exponential bound; an exact first-moment formula is not a distributional convergence theorem. The fully reciprocal Perrin endpoint and equilibrium/kernel correspondence are known.
title: Any positive reciprocity creates exponentially many specialized equilibria on random rings
